title: Toddler Sitting in Grass, 1920s Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot featuring a young toddler sitting on a grassy lawn outdoors. The child wears a light-colored tunic or shirt, dark stockings, shoes, and a two-tone beanie cap, holding a small toy whistle in their mouth. The photograph captures a sweet moment of early 20th-century childhood candid portraiture.
